bagged_desc_fmt: This {0} has been captured and is now safe to relocate.

plant_mutations.unidentified_desc: This seed must be identified at the Botanical Analyzer before it can be planted.

moderatelyloose.name: Easygoing
moderatelyloose.description: Plants with this mutation are easier to take care of, but don't yield as much produce.

moderatelytight.name: Specialized
moderatelytight.description: Plants with this mutation are pickier about their conditions but yield more produce.

extremelytight.name: Superspecialized
extremelytight.description: Plants with this mutation are very difficult to keep alive, but produce a bounty.

bonuslice.name: Licey
bonuslice.description: Something about this mutation causes Meal Lice to pupate on this plant.

sunnyspeed.name: Leafy
sunnyspeed.description: This mutation provides the plant with sun-collecting leaves, allowing faster growth.

slowburn.name: Wildish
slowburn.description: These plants grow almost as slow as their wild cousins, but also consume almost no fertilizer.

blooms.name: Blooming
blooms.description: Vestigial flowers increase the beauty of this plant. Don't inhale the pollen, though!

loadedwithfruit.name: Bountiful
loadedwithfruit.description: This mutation produces lots of extra produce, though it also takes a long time to pick it all!

rottenheaps.name: Exuberant
rottenheaps.description: Plants with this mutation grow extremely quickly, though the produce they make is sometimes questionable.

heavyfruit.name: Juicy Fruits
heavyfruit.description: Extra water in these plump mutant veggies causes them to fall right off the plant! There's no extra nutritional value, though...

crab.name: Pokeshell
crab.desc:
Pokeshells are nonhostile critters unless their eggs are nearby.

They eat Polluted Dirt and Rot Piles.

The shells they leave behind after molting can be crushed into Lime.

baby.name: Pokeshell Spawn
baby.desc:
A snippy little Pokeshell Spawn.

In time it will mature into a fully grown Pokeshell.

variant_wood.name: Oakshell
variant_wood.desc:
Oakshells are nonhostile critters unless their eggs are nearby.

They eat Polluted Dirt, Slime and Rot Piles.

The shells they leave behind after molting can be crushed into Wood.

Oakshells thrive in Ethanol.

baby.name: Oakshell Spawn
baby.desc:
A knotty little Oakshell Spawn.

In time it will mature into a fully grown Oakshell.

variant_fresh_water.name: Sanishell
variant_fresh_water.desc:
Sanishells are nonhostile critters unless their eggs are nearby.

They thrive in Water and eliminate Germs from any liquid it inhabits.

They eat Polluted Dirt, Slime and Rot Piles.

baby.name: Sanishell Spawn
baby.desc:
A picky little Sanishell Spawn.

In time it will mature into a fully grown Sanishell.

chameleon.name: Dartle
chameleon.desc:
Dartles are non-hostile critters who eat Dewdrips and excrete Bleach Stone and Chlorine Gas .

They are preyed on by Rhexes.

baby.name: Dartlet
baby.desc:
A wide-eyed little Dartlet.

Someday it will mature into a fully grown Dartle.

mosquito.name: Gnit
mosquito.desc:
Gnits are hostile airborne critters primarily bred as food for the carnivorous Lura Plants to produce Amber.

Their offspring must be exposed to Liquid in order to survive.

baby.name: Gnit Larva
baby.desc:
A wiggly little Gnit Larva.

In time, it will mature into an irritating Gnit.

bee.name: Beeta
bee.desc:
Beetas are hostile critters that thrive in Radioactive environments.

They commonly gather Uranium Ore for their Beeta Hives to produce Enriched Uranium.

baby.name: Beetiny
baby.desc:
A harmless little Beetiny.

In time, it will mature into a vicious adult Beeta.

chlorinegeyser.name: Chlorine Geyser
chlorinegeyser.desc: A highly pressurized geyser that periodically erupts with Chlorine Gas.

pacu.name: Pacu
pacu.desc:
Pacus are aquatic creatures that can live in any liquid, such as Water or Polluted Water.

Every organism in the known universe finds the Pacu extremely delicious.

baby.name: Pacu Fry
baby.desc:
A wriggly little Pacu Fry.

In time, it will mature into an adult Pacu.

variant_tropical.name: Tropical Pacu
variant_tropical.desc:
Tropical Pacus are aquatic critters who inhabit warm liquid pools.

Their vibrant colors provide a significant Decor boost to their environment.

baby.name: Tropical Fry
baby.desc:
A wriggly little Tropical Fry.

In time it will mature into an adult Pacu morph, the Tropical Pacu.

variant_cleaner.name: Gulp Fish
variant_cleaner.desc:
Gulp Fishes are aquatic critters who inhabit cold liquid pools.

Their gills filter Polluted Water into Water.

baby.name: Gulp Fry
baby.desc:
A wriggly little Gulp Fry.

In time, it will mature into an adult Gulp Fish.

glom.name: Morb
glom.desc: Morbs are attracted to unhygienic conditions and frequently excrete bursts of Polluted Oxygen.

hatch.name: Hatch
hatch.desc: Hatches excrete solid Coal as waste and may be uncovered by digging up Buried Objects.

baby.name: Hatchling
baby.desc:
An innocent little Hatchling.

In time, it will mature into an adult Hatch.

variant_hard.name: Stone Hatch
variant_hard.desc: Stone Hatches excrete solid Coal as waste and enjoy burrowing into the ground.

baby.name: Stone Hatchling
baby.desc:
A doofy little Stone Hatchling.

It matures into an adult Hatch morph, the Stone Hatch, which loves nibbling on various rocks and metals.

variant_veggie.name: Sage Hatch
variant_veggie.desc: Sage Hatches excrete solid Coal as waste and enjoy burrowing into the ground.

baby.name: Sage Hatchling
baby.desc:
A doofy little Sage Hatchling.

It matures into an adult Hatch morph, the Sage Hatch, which loves nibbling on organic materials.

variant_metal.name: Smooth Hatch
variant_metal.desc: Smooth Hatches enjoy burrowing into the ground and excrete Refined Metal when fed Metal Ore.

baby.name: Smooth Hatchling
baby.desc:
A doofy little Smooth Hatchling.

It matures into an adult Hatch morph, the Smooth Hatch, which loves nibbling on different types of metals.

staterpillar.name: Plug Slug
staterpillar.desc:
Plug Slugs are dynamic creatures that generate electrical Power during the night.

Their power can be harnessed by leaving an exposed wire near areas where they like to sleep.

baby.name: Plug Sluglet
baby.desc:
A chubby little Plug Sluglet.

In time it will mature into a fully grown Plug Slug.

variant_gas.name: Smog Slug
variant_gas.desc:
Smog Slugs are porous creatures that draw in unbreathable Gases during the day.

At night, they sleep near exposed Gas Pipes, where they deposit their cache.

baby.name: Smog Sluglet
baby.desc:
A tubby little Smog Sluglet.

In time it will mature into a fully grown Smog Slug.

variant_liquid.name: Sponge Slug
variant_liquid.desc:
Sponge Slugs are thirsty creatures that soak up Liquids during the day.

They deposit their stored Liquids into the exposed Liquid Pipes they sleep next to at night.

baby.name: Sponge Sluglet
baby.desc:
A chonky little Sponge Sluglet.

In time it will mature into a fully grown Sponge Slug.

variant_beetle.name: Sweetle
variant_beetle.desc:
Sweetles are nonhostile critters that excrete large amounts of Sucrose.

They are closely related to the Grubgrub and exhibit similar, albeit less effective farming behaviors.

baby.name: Sweetle Larva
baby.desc:
A crawly little Sweetle Larva.

In time, it will mature into an adult Sweetle.

variant_worm.name: Grubgrub
variant_worm.desc:
Grubgrubs form symbiotic relationships with plants, especially Grubfruit Plants, and instinctually tend to them.

Grubgrubs are closely related to Sweetles.

baby.name: Grubgrub Wormling
baby.desc:
A squirmy little Grubgrub Wormling.

In time, it will mature into an adult Grubgrub and drastically grow in size.

drecko.name: Drecko
drecko.desc:
Dreckos are nonhostile critters that graze on Pincha Pepperplants, Balm Lily or Mealwood Plants.

Their backsides are covered in thick woolly fibers that only grow in Hydrogen climates.

baby.name: Drecklet
baby.desc:
A little, bug-eyed Drecklet.

In time it will mature into a fully grown Drecko.

variant_plastic.name: Glossy Drecko
variant_plastic.desc:
Glossy Dreckos are nonhostile critters that graze on live Mealwood Plants and Bristle Blossoms.

Their backsides are covered in bioplastic scales that only grow in Hydrogen Gas climates.

baby.name: Glossy Drecklet
baby.desc:
A bug-eyed little Glossy Drecklet.

In time it will mature into an adult Drecko morph, the Glossy Drecko.

wooddeer.name: Flox
wooddeer.desc:
Floxes are nonhostile critters that graze on Bristle Blossoms and Pikeapples.

When Flox antlers are fully grown, they harden into shearable Wood.

baby.name: Flox Fawn
baby.desc:
A little yipping Flox Fawn.

In time it will mature into a fully grown Flox.

glassdeer.name: Shatter Flox
glassdeer.desc:
Shatter Floxes are nonhostile critters that can subsist on Bristle Blossom and Pikeapple Bush.

Their shearable Glass antlers grow only when they are fed Abyssalite.

baby.name: Shatter Flox Fawn
baby.desc:
A little yipping Shatter Flox Fawn.

In time it will mature into a fully grown Shatter Flox.

icebelly.name: Bammoth
icebelly.desc:
Bammoths are lumbering, nonhostile creatures that subsist on Plume Squash, Nosh Beans and Squash Fries.

Their thick overcoats can be shorn for Reed Fiber.

baby.name: Bammini
baby.desc:
A floofy little Bammini.

In time it will mature into a fully grown Bammoth.

variant_gold.name: Regal Bammoth
variant_gold.desc:
Regal Bammoths are nonhostile creatures that subsist on Plume Squash and Nosh Beans.

Their ornate crests grow only when they are fed Squash Fries.

baby.name: Regal Bammini
baby.desc:
A haughty little Regal Bammini.

In time it will mature into a fully grown Regal Bammoth.

seal.name: Spigot Seal
seal.desc:
Spigot Seals are charismatic creatures who produce Ethanol.

They eat Sucrose, and drink Nectar straight from the Bonbon Tree.

baby.name: Spigot Pup
baby.desc:
A wobbly little Spigot Pup.

In time, it will mature into an adult Spigot Seal.

squirrel.name: Pip
squirrel.desc:
Pips are pesky, nonhostile critters that subsist on Thimble Reeds and Arbor Tree branches.

They are known to bury Seeds in the ground whenever they can find a suitable area with enough space.

baby.name: Pipsqueak
baby.desc:
A little purring Pipsqueak.

In time it will mature into a fully grown Pip.

variant_hug.name: Cuddle Pip
variant_hug.desc:
Cuddle Pips are fluffy, affectionate critters who exhibit a strong snuggling instinct towards all types of eggs.

This is temporarily amplified when they are hugged by a passing Duplicant.

baby.name: Cuddle Pipsqueak
baby.desc:
A fuzzy little Cuddle Pipsqueak.

In time it will mature into a fully grown Cuddle Pip.

oilfloater.name: Slickster
oilfloater.desc: Slicksters are slimy critters that consume Carbon Dioxide and exude Crude Oil.

baby.name: Slickster Larva
baby.desc:
A goopy little Slickster Larva.

One day it will grow into an adult Slickster.

variant_hightemp.name: Molten Slickster
variant_hightemp.desc: Molten Slicksters are slimy critters that consume Carbon Dioxide and exude Petroleum.

baby.name: Molten Larva
baby.desc:
A goopy little Molten Larva.

One day it will grow into an adult Slickster morph, the Molten Slickster.

variant_decor.name: Longhair Slickster
variant_decor.desc:
Longhair Slicksters are friendly critters that consume Oxygen and thrive in close contact with Duplicant companions.

Longhairs have extremely beautiful and luxurious coats.

baby.name: Longhair Larva
baby.desc:
A snuggly little Longhair Larva.

One day it will grow into an adult Slickster morph, the Longhair Slickster.

puft.name: Puft
puft.desc: Pufts are non-aggressive critters that excrete lumps of Slime with each breath.

baby.name: Puftlet
baby.desc:
A gassy little Puftlet.

In time it will grow into an adult Puft.

variant_alpha.name: Puft Prince
variant_alpha.desc: The Puft Prince is a lazy critter that excretes little Solid lumps of whatever it has been breathing.

baby.name: Puftlet Prince
baby.desc:
A gassy little Puftlet Prince.

One day it will grow into an adult Puft morph, the Puft Prince.

It seems a bit snobby...

variant_oxylite.name: Dense Puft
variant_oxylite.desc: Dense Pufts are non-aggressive critters that excrete condensed Oxylite with each breath.

baby.name: Dense Puftlet
baby.desc:
A stocky little Dense Puftlet.

One day it will grow into an adult Puft morph, the Dense Puft.

variant_bleachstone.name: Squeaky Puft
variant_bleachstone.desc: Squeaky Pufts are non-aggressive critters that excrete lumps of Bleachstone with each breath.

baby.name: Squeaky Puftlet
baby.desc:
A frazzled little Squeaky Puftlet.

One day it will grow into an adult Puft morph, the Squeaky Puft.

moo.name: Gassy Moo
moo.desc:
Moos are extraterrestrial critters that feed on Gas Grass and excrete Natural Gas.

When domesticated and fed, they can be milked for Brackene.

dieselmoo.name: Husky Moo
dieselmoo.desc:
Husky Moos are extraterrestrial critters that feed on Plant Husk and Gas Grass, and excrete Carbon Dioxide.

When domesticated and fed, they can be milked for Biodiesel.

mole.name: Shove Vole
mole.desc:
Shove Voles are burrowing critters that eat the Regolith collected on terrestrial surfaces.

They cannot burrow through Refined Metals.

baby.name: Vole Pup
baby.desc:
A snuggly little pup.

One day it will grow into an adult Shove Vole.

variant_delicacy.name: Delecta Vole
variant_delicacy.desc:
Delecta Voles are burrowing critters whose bodies sprout shearable Tonic Root when Regolith is ingested at preferred temperatures.

They cannot burrow through Refined Metals.

baby.name: Delecta Vole Pup
baby.desc:
A tender little Delecta Vole pup.

One day it will grow into an adult Shove Vole morph, the Delecta Vole.

shockworm.name: Shockworm
shockworm.desc: Shockworms are exceptionally aggressive and discharge electrical shocks to stun their prey.

lightbug.name: Shine Bug
lightbug.desc:
Shine Bugs emit a soft Light in hopes of attracting more of their kind for company.

Their eggs contain small amounts of Resin that can be harvested when cracked at the Egg Cracker.

baby.name: Shine Nymph
baby.desc: A chubby baby Shine Bug.

variant_orange.name: Sun Bug
variant_orange.desc:
Sun Bugs emit a soft orange Light in hopes of attracting more of their kind for company.

Their eggs contain small amounts of Resin that can be harvested when cracked at the Egg Cracker.

baby.name: Sun Nymph
baby.desc:
A chubby baby Shine Bug.

This one is a Sun morph.

variant_purple.name: Royal Bug
variant_purple.desc:
Royal Bugs emit a soft purple Light in hopes of attracting more of their kind for company.

Their eggs contain small amounts of Resin that can be harvested when cracked at the Egg Cracker.

baby.name: Royal Nymph
baby.desc:
A chubby baby Shine Bug.

This one is a Royal morph.

variant_pink.name: Coral Bug
variant_pink.desc:
Coral Bugs emit a soft pink Light in hopes of attracting more of their kind for company.

Their eggs contain small amounts of Resin that can be harvested when cracked at the Egg Cracker.

baby.name: Coral Nymph
baby.desc:
A chubby baby Shine Bug.

This one is a Coral morph.

variant_blue.name: Azure Bug
variant_blue.desc:
Azure Bugs emit a soft blue Light in hopes of attracting more of their kind for company.

Their eggs contain small amounts of Resin that can be harvested when cracked at the Egg Cracker.

baby.name: Azure Nymph
baby.desc:
A chubby baby Shine Bug.

This one is an Azure morph.

variant_black.name: Abyss Bug
variant_black.desc:
This Shine Bug emits no Light, but it makes up for it by having an excellent personality.

Their eggs contain small amounts of Resin that can be harvested when cracked at the Egg Cracker.

baby.name: Abyss Nymph
baby.desc:
A chubby baby Shine Bug.

This one is an Abyss morph.

variant_crystal.name: Radiant Bug
variant_crystal.desc:
Radiant Bugs emit an extra-bright Light in hopes of attracting more of their kind for company.

Their eggs contain small amounts of Resin that can be harvested when cracked at the Egg Cracker.

baby.name: Radiant Nymph
baby.desc:
A chubby baby Shine Bug.

This one is a Radiant morph.

variant_radioactive.name: Ionizing Bug
variant_radioactive.desc: Shine Bugs emit a dangerously radioactive Light in hopes of attracting more of their kind for company.

baby.name: Ionizing Nymph
baby.desc:
A chubby baby Shine Bug.

This one is an Ionizing morph.

raptor.name: Rhex
raptor.desc:
Rhexes are carnivorous critters that feed on smaller Critters and produce Brine Ice.

Their tailfeathers can be shorn for Feather Fiber.

baby.name: Rhex Baby
baby.desc:
A feathery little Rhex fledgling.

One day, it will grow into a fearsome Rhex.

prehistoricpacu.name: Jawbo
prehistoricpacu.desc:
Jawbos are carnivorous aquatic critters that feed on Pacus and produce Rust.

They pose no danger to Duplicants.

baby.name: Jawbo Fry
baby.desc:
A grumpy little Jawbo fry.

In time, it will grow into a toothy Jawbo.

stego.name: Lumb
stego.desc:
Lumbs are non-hostile critters that subsist on Ovagro vines.

When they stomp heavily near plants, the commotion causes harvestable items to fall to the ground.

baby.name: Lumblet
baby.desc:
A heavy-footed little Lumb baby.

In time, it will grow into a stompy Lumb.

algae_stego.name: Blum Lumb
algae_stego.desc:
Blum Lumbs are non-hostile critters that produce Algae.

When they stomp heavily near plants, the commotion causes harvestable items to fall to the ground.

baby.name: Blumblet
baby.desc:
A slightly moist Blum Lumb baby.

In time, it will grow into a stompy Blum Lumb.

butterfly.name: Mimika
butterfly.desc:
Mimikas are airborne organisms that help nearby Plants grow more quickly.

When its leaves dry up, it will harden into Mimillet.

geyser.name: Steam Geyser
geyser.desc: A highly pressurized geyser that periodically erupts, spraying Steam and boiling hot Water.

steam.name: Cool Steam Vent
steam.desc: A highly pressurized vent that periodically erupts with Steam.

hot_steam.name: Steam Vent
hot_steam.desc: A highly pressurized vent that periodically erupts with scalding Steam.

salt_water.name: Salt Water Geyser
salt_water.desc: A highly pressurized geyser that periodically erupts with Salt Water.

slush_salt_water.name: Cool Salt Slush Geyser
slush_salt_water.desc: A highly pressurized geyser that periodically erupts with freezing Brine.

hot_water.name: Water Geyser
hot_water.desc: A highly pressurized geyser that periodically erupts with hot Water.

slush_water.name: Cool Slush Geyser
slush_water.desc: A highly pressurized geyser that periodically erupts with freezing Polluted Water.

filthy_water.name: Polluted Water Vent
filthy_water.desc: A highly pressurized vent that periodically erupts with boiling Polluted Water.

small_volcano.name: Minor Volcano
small_volcano.desc: A miniature volcano that periodically erupts with molten Magma.

big_volcano.name: Volcano
big_volcano.desc: A massive volcano that periodically erupts with molten Magma.

liquid_co2.name: Carbon Dioxide Geyser
liquid_co2.desc: A highly pressurized geyser that periodically erupts with boiling Liquid Carbon Dioxide.

hot_co2.name: Carbon Dioxide Vent
hot_co2.desc: A highly pressurized vent that periodically erupts with hot Carbon Dioxide.

hot_hydrogen.name: Hydrogen Vent
hot_hydrogen.desc: A highly pressurized vent that periodically erupts with hot gaseous Hydrogen.

hot_po2.name: Hot Polluted Oxygen Vent
hot_po2.desc: A highly pressurized vent that periodically erupts with hot Polluted Oxygen.

slimy_po2.name: Infectious Polluted Oxygen Vent
slimy_po2.desc: A highly pressurized vent that periodically erupts with warm Polluted Oxygen.

chlorine_gas.name: Chlorine Gas Vent
chlorine_gas.desc: A highly pressurized vent that periodically erupts with warm Chlorine Gas.

chlorine_gas_cool.name: Cool Chlorine Gas Vent
chlorine_gas_cool.desc: A highly pressurized vent that periodically erupts with cool Chlorine Gas.

methane.name: Natural Gas Geyser
methane.desc: A highly pressurized geyser that periodically erupts with hot Natural Gas.

molten_copper.name: Copper Volcano
molten_copper.desc: A large volcano that periodically erupts with Molten Copper.

molten_iron.name: Iron Volcano
molten_iron.desc: A large volcano that periodically erupts with Molten Iron.

molten_aluminum.name: Aluminum Volcano
molten_aluminum.desc: A large volcano that periodically erupts with Molten Aluminum.

molten_tungsten.name: Tungsten Volcano
molten_tungsten.desc: A large volcano that periodically erupts with Molten Tungsten.

molten_gold.name: Gold Volcano
molten_gold.desc: A large volcano that periodically erupts with Molten Gold.

molten_cobalt.name: Cobalt Volcano
molten_cobalt.desc: A large volcano that periodically erupts with Molten Cobalt.

molten_niobium.name: Niobium Volcano
molten_niobium.desc: A large volcano that periodically erupts with Niobium.

oil_drip.name: Leaky Oil Fissure
oil_drip.desc: A fissure that periodically erupts with boiling Crude Oil.

liquid_sulfur.name: Liquid Sulfur Geyser
liquid_sulfur.desc: A highly pressurized geyser that periodically erupts with boiling Liquid Sulfur.

methanegeyser.name: Natural Gas Geyser
methanegeyser.desc: A highly pressurized geyser that periodically erupts with Natural Gas.

oil_well.name: Oil Reservoir
oil_well.desc:
Oil Reservoirs are rock formations with Crude Oil deposits beneath their surface.

Oil can be extracted from a reservoir with sufficient pressure.

mushroomplant.name: Dusk Cap
mushroomplant.desc: Dusk Caps produce Mushrooms, fungal growths that can be harvested for Food.

steamspout.name: Steam Spout
steamspout.desc: A rocky vent that spouts Steam.

propanespout.name: Propane Spout
propanespout.desc: A rocky vent that spouts Propane Gas.

oilspout.name: Oil Spout
oilspout.desc: A rocky vent that spouts Crude Oil.

pacuegg.name: Pacu Egg
pacuegg.desc:
A tiny Pacu is nestled inside.

It is not yet ready for the world.

mysteryegg.name: Mysterious Egg
mysteryegg.desc: What's growing inside? Something nice? Something mean?

swamplily.name: Balm Lily
swamplily.desc: Balm Lilies produce Balm Lily Flower, a lovely bloom with medicinal properties.
swamplily.domesticateddesc: This plant produces medicinal Balm Lily Flower.

junglegasplant.name: Palmera Tree
junglegasplant.desc:
A large, chlorine-dwelling Plant that can be grown in farm buildings.

Palmeras grow inedible buds that emit unbreathable hydrogen gas.
junglegasplant.domesticateddesc: A large, chlorine-dwelling Plant that grows inedible buds which emit unbreathable hydrogen gas.

prickleflower.name: Bristle Blossom
prickleflower.desc: Bristle Blossoms produce Bristle Berry, a prickly edible bud.
prickleflower.domesticateddesc: This plant produces edible Bristle Berries.

coldwheat.name: Sleet Wheat
coldwheat.desc: Sleet Wheat produces Sleet Wheat Grain, a chilly grain that can be processed into Food.
coldwheat.domesticateddesc: This plant produces edible Sleet Wheat Grain.

gasgrass.name: Gas Grass
gasgrass.desc:
Gas Grass is an alien lifeform tentatively categorized as a "plant."

It can be harvested for Plant Husk or eaten as-is by Moos.
gasgrass.domesticateddesc: An alien grass variety that is eaten by Gassy Moos.

pinkrock.name: Lumen Quartz
pinkrock.desc:
Lumen quartz emits a soft glowing Light that makes everything look and feel a little rosier.

It's even brighter and more beautiful once it's been carved.
pinkrock.codex: Lumen quartz is a naturally occurring object found in the Cool Pool biome.

pinkrockcarved.name: Carved Lumen Quartz
pinkrockcarved.desc: A Duplicant has carved this Lumen quartz in a way that really maximizes its Decor value and brightness.

pricklegrass.name: Bluff Briar
pricklegrass.desc: Bluff Briars exude pheromones causing critters to view them as especially beautiful.

cylindrica.name: Bliss Burst
cylindrica.desc: Bliss Bursts release an explosion of Decor into otherwise dull environments.

toeplant.name: Tranquil Toes
toeplant.desc: Tranquil Toes improve Decor by giving their surroundings the visual equivalent of a foot rub.

winecups.name: Mellow Mallow
winecups.desc: Mellow Mallows heighten Decor and alleviate Stress with their calming color and cradle shape.

evilflower.name: Sporechid
evilflower.desc: Sporechids have an eerily alluring appearance to mask the fact that they host particularly nasty strain of brain fungus.
evilflower.domesticateddesc: This plant improves ambient Decor but produces high quantities of Zombie Spores.

leafyplant.name: Mirth Leaf
leafyplant.desc: Mirth Leaves sport a calm green hue known for alleviating Stress and improving Morale.

cactusplant.name: Jumping Joya
cactusplant.desc: Joyas are Decorative Plants that are colloquially said to make gardeners "jump for joy".

bulbplant.name: Buddy Bud
bulbplant.desc: Buddy Buds are leafy plants that have a positive effect on Morale, much like a friend.

iceflower.name: Idylla Flower
iceflower.desc:
Idyllas are Decorative Plants with soft, pompom-shaped blossoms.

Gazing dreamily at them has a positive effect on Morale.

hardskinberryplant.name: Pikeapple Bush
hardskinberryplant.desc: Pikeapple bushes produce Pikeapple, a useful yet almost unbearably fragrant Food.

carrotplant.name: Plume Squash Plant
carrotplant.desc: Plume Squashes are sweet, nutrient-rich tubers that can be harvested for Food.
carrotplant.domesticateddesc: This plant produces edible Plume Squash.

spacetree.name: Bonbon Tree
spacetree.desc:
Bonbon Tree branches synthesize Light to produce Nectar.

Branches can be harvested for Wood.

Bonbon Trees can shed most environmental debris, and rarely become entombed.
spacetree.domesticateddesc: This plant produces Nectar and Wood.

blue_grass.name: Alveo Vera
blue_grass.desc: Alveo Veras consume Carbon Dioxide and Ice, and form harvestable Oxylite deposits.

basicsingleharvestplant.name: Mealwood
basicsingleharvestplant.desc: Mealwoods produce Meal Lice, an oddly wriggly grain that can be harvested for Food.
basicsingleharvestplant.domesticateddesc: This plant produces edible Meal Lice.

dewdripperplant.name: Dew Dripper
dewdripperplant.desc: Dew Drippers produce Dewdrips that can be crushed into Brackene.

swampharvestplant.name: Bog Bucket
swampharvestplant.desc: Bog Buckets produce juicy, sweet Bog Jellies for Food.
swampharvestplant.domesticateddesc: This plant produces edible Bog Jellies.

wormplant.name: Spindly Grubfruit Plant
wormplant.desc:
Spindly Grubfruit Plants produce Spindly Grubfruit for Food.

If it is tended by a Divergent critter, it will produce high quality fruits instead.
wormplant.domesticateddesc: This plant produces edible Spindly Grubfruit.

superwormplant.name: Grubfruit Plant
superwormplant.desc:
A Grubfruit Plant that has flourished after being tended by a Divergent critter.

It will produce high quality Grubfruits.

basicfabricmaterialplant.name: Thimble Reed
basicfabricmaterialplant.desc: Thimble Reeds produce indescribably soft Reed Fiber for Clothing production.

basicforageplantplanted.name: Buried Muckroot
basicforageplantplanted.desc: Muckroots are incapable of propagating but can be harvested for a single Food serving.

icecavesforageplantplanted.name: Sherberry Plant
icecavesforageplantplanted.desc: Sherberries are incapable of propagating, but can be harvested for a single Food serving.

forestforageplantplanted.name: Hexalent
forestforageplantplanted.desc: Hexalents are incapable of propagating but can be harvested for a single, calorie dense Food serving.

swampforageplantplanted.name: Swamp Chard
swampforageplantplanted.desc: Swamp Chards are incapable of propagating but can be harvested for a single low quality and calorie dense Food serving.

coldbreather.name: Wheezewort
coldbreather.desc: Wheezeworts can be planted in Planter Boxes, Farm Tiles or Hydroponic Farms, and absorb Heat by respiring through their porous outer membranes.

coldbreathercluster.name: Wheezewort
coldbreathercluster.desc: Wheezeworts can be planted in Planter Boxes, Farm Tiles or Hydroponic Farms, and absorb Heat by respiring through their porous outer membranes.

dinofern.name: Megafrond
dinofern.desc: Megafronds produce Megafrond Grain, an ancient grain that can be processed into Food.

flytrapplant.name: Lura Plant
flytrapplant.desc:
Lura plants are carnivorous plants that trap flying critters, such as Gnits.

Their digestive processes produce harvestable Amber.

kelpplant.name: Seakomb
kelpplant.desc:
Seakombs consume Polluted Dirt.

Their leaves can be processed to extract Phyto Oil.

spice_vine.name: Pincha Pepperplant
spice_vine.desc: Pincha Pepperplants produce flavorful Pincha Peppernut for spicing Food.
spice_vine.domesticateddesc: This plant produces Pincha Peppernut spices.

saltplant.name: Dasha Saltvine
saltplant.desc: Dasha Saltvines consume small amounts of Chlorine Gas and form sodium deposits as they grow, producing harvestable Salt.

filterplant.name: Hydrocactus
filterplant.desc: Hydrocacti act as natural Water filters when given access to Sand.
filterplant.domesticateddesc: This plant uses Sand to convert Polluted Water into Water.

vinemother.name: Ovagro Node
vinemother.desc:
Ovagro Nodes are trellis plants that spread onto nearby available surfaces.

A single Ovagro Node can support several Ovagro Vines without any increase in its Water requirements.

vinebranch.name: Ovagro Vine
vinebranch.desc:
Ovagro Vines are plants that produce edible Ovagro Fig.

If a vine is cut off from its Ovagro Node, it will perish.

oxyfern.name: Oxyfern
oxyfern.desc: Oxyferns absorb Carbon Dioxide Gas and exude breathable Oxygen.
oxyfern.domesticateddesc: This plant converts Carbon Dioxide into Oxygen.

bean_plant.name: Nosh Sprout
bean_plant.desc: Nosh Sprouts thrive in colder climates and produce edible Nosh Beans.

wood_tree.name: Arbor Tree
wood_tree.desc: Arbor Trees grow Arbor Tree Branches and can be harvested for Wood.
wood_tree.domesticateddesc: This plant produces Arbor Tree Branches that can be harvested for Wood.

wood_tree_branch.name: Arbor Tree Branch
wood_tree_branch.desc: Arbor Trees Branches can be harvested for Wood.

sealettuce.name: Waterweed
sealettuce.desc: Waterweeds thrive in salty water and can be harvested for fresh, edible Lettuce.

crittertrapplant.name: Saturn Critter Trap
crittertrapplant.desc: Critter Traps are carnivorous plants that consume small-to-medium-sized critters and release Hydrogen Gas as waste.
crittertrapplant.domesticateddesc: This plant eats small critters and produces Hydrogen Gas.

saptree.name: Experiment 52B
saptree.desc:
A Sap-producing cybernetic tree that shows signs of sentience.

It is rooted firmly in place, and is waiting for some brave soul to bring it food.

gardenfoodplant.name: Sweatcorn Stalk
gardenfoodplant.desc: Sweatcorn Stalks produce Sweatcorn, a crisp vegetable that can be harvested for Food.

gardenforageplantplanted.name: Snactus
gardenforageplantplanted.desc: Snacti are incapable of propagating but can be harvested for a single Food serving.

butterflyplant.name: Mimika Bud
butterflyplant.desc:
Mimika Buds are self-harvesting plants that produce airborne Mimikas.

Mimikas boost growth for nearby Plants before hardening into Mimillet.

gardendecorplant.name: Ring Rosebush
gardendecorplant.desc: Ring Rosebushes are Decorative Plants that add a touch of whimsy wherever they are planted.
